Plot Expression of Significant Features

Source: R/modeling_and_visualization.R
plotSigFeatures.Rd

Creates a boxplot to visualize the expression levels of significant features identified by the model, grouped by outcome. Optionally overlays statistical significance labels on the plot.

Usage

plotSigFeatures(stats, sigFeatures, outcome, title = "", type = "density")

Arguments

stats

Data frame containing statistical results for each feature.

sigFeatures

Data frame of significant features and their expression levels.

outcome

Character; name of the outcome variable to group by.

title

Character; title of the plot, default is an empty string.

test

Logical; if TRUE, applies significance testing and displays p-values, default is FALSE.

Value

A ggplot object representing the boxplot of significant features.

Examples

# Load sample data
data(sample_data_logit)
data(sample_markerMeans)
data(sample_groups)
data(sample_clinicaldata)

# Prepare and fit model
X_train <- cbind(sample_data_logit, sample_markerMeans)
X_train <- scale(X_train)
y_train <- as.numeric(sample_clinicaldata$Outcome) - 1

fit <- fitModel(X_train, y_train, sample_groups, penalty = "grLasso")

# Get significant features
sig_features <- getSigFeatures(
  fit = fit$fit,
  type = "prop",
  prop = sample_data_logit,
  clinicalData = sample_clinicaldata,
  outcome = "Outcome"
)

# Plot if features found
if(!is.null(sig_features$sigFeatures) && nrow(sig_features$stats) > 0) {
  # Boxplot
  p1 <- plotSigFeatures(
    stats = sig_features$stats,
    sigFeatures = sig_features$sigFeatures,
    outcome = "Outcome",
    type = "boxplot"
  )
  print(p1)
  
  # Density plot
  p2 <- plotSigFeatures(
    stats = sig_features$stats,
    sigFeatures = sig_features$sigFeatures,
    outcome = "Outcome",
    type = "density"
  )
  print(p2)
}
